often.note: The spelling pronunciation with an audible /t/ (ˈɒf.tən, ˈɑːf.tən) is common in both varieties.

examples: We often walk along the river after supper.
How often do the buses run on Sundays?
She does not write often, but her letters are long.

senses.definition: An occasion or situation that makes it possible to do something you want to do.
examples: The fellowship gave her the opportunity to work abroad.
I would like to take this opportunity to thank the volunteers.
Do not miss the opportunity to ask questions at the end.
